settings.subClashAutoDetect: Clash/Mihomo クライアントを自動検出
settings.subClashAutoDetectDesc: 有効にすると、標準サブスクリプション URL を要求する既知の Clash/Mihomo クライアントへ Clash YAML を自動的に返します。ブラウザには引き続きサブスクリプションページを表示し、その他のクライアントには従来の raw/Base64 応答を返します。明示的な JSON および Clash URL も引き続き利用できます。Clash/Mihomo サブスクリプションを有効にし、適用のためにパネルを再起動する必要があります。
settings.subClashUserAgentRegexDesc: 標準サブスクリプション URL で Clash/Mihomo クライアントを識別するため、クライアントの User-Agent と照合する Go RE2 正規表現です。空欄の場合は既定のパターンを使用します。変更後にパネルを再起動してください。

reference.programmaticInterfaceToA3XUIPanelAuthent: Programmatic interface to a 3X-UI panel. Authenticate either by logging in (cookie) or with a scoped API token from Settings → Security → API Token (Bearer). Token access is limited by its admin, monitor, node-sync, or node-admin scope; treat admin tokens like the panel password.
reference.scopedAPITokenFromSettingsSecurityAPITok: Scoped API token from Settings → Security → API Token. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
reference.sessionCookieSetByPOSTLoginBrowserOnly: Session cookie set by POST /login. Browser-only.
reference.happClientCustomizationSettingsAppManage: Happ client customization settings (app-management / routing / UX).
reference.incyClientCustomizationSettingsAppManage:
Incy client customization settings (app-management). A "" value omits
the header so the subscriber's own app setting is left alone.
reference.amneziawglogsIsWhatTheOverviewSAmneziaWG:
AmneziaWGLogs is what the overview's AmneziaWG log view renders: the live
per-peer activity of every running embedded interface, plus the panel's
own recent AmneziaWG lifecycle log lines that explain a peer being absent
from Peers at all.
reference.sha256HashThePlaintextIsShownOnlyOnceAt: SHA-256 hash; the plaintext is shown only once at creation
reference.clientRepresentsAClientConfigurationForX: Client represents a client configuration for Xray inbounds with traffic limits and settings.
reference.allowedipsbyinboundOptionallyOverridesAl:
AllowedIPsByInbound optionally overrides AllowedIPs on a per-inbound
basis, keyed by inbound id. Lets one identity attached to both
WireGuard and AmneziaWG carry two genuinely different addresses in a
single Create/Update call instead of the shared AllowedIPs field
being broadcast to every attached tunnel inbound. Absent/unset for a
given inbound id falls back to the shared AllowedIPs exactly as
before -- fully backward compatible for callers that never set this.
reference.secondsBetweenPersistentKeepalivePackets: Seconds between PersistentKeepalive packets; 0 sends none, omit to keep the stored value
reference.calendarRenewalDay1310DisablesMonthlyRen: Calendar renewal day 1-31, 0 disables monthly renewal
reference.perClientTrafficResetCycleIndependentOfT: Per-client traffic reset cycle, independent of the inbound's own (#5497).
reference.clientpageresponseIsTheShapeReturnedByLi:
ClientPageResponse is the shape returned by ListPaged. `Total` is the
row count in the DB; `Filtered` is the count after Search/Filter/Protocol
were applied, before pagination. The page contains at most PageSize items.
Summary is computed across the full DB row set so dashboard counters
on the clients page stay stable as the user paginates/filters.
reference.clientslimIsTheRowShapeUsedByTheClientsP:
ClientSlim is the row-shape used by the clients page. It drops fields the
table never reads (UUID, password, auth, flow, security, reverse, tgId)
so the list payload stays compact even when the panel manages thousands
of clients. Modals that need the full record still call /get/:email.
reference.clienttrafficRepresentsTrafficStatistics:
ClientTraffic represents traffic statistics and limits for a specific client.
It tracks upload/download usage, expiry times, and online status for inbound clients.
reference.resetcountIsHowManyHaveFiredSoAPrepaidPl: ResetCount is how many have fired, so a prepaid plan stops on its own.
reference.resetdayRenewsOnThatDayOfEachCalendarMon:
ResetDay renews on that day of each calendar month instead of every
Reset days; 0 disables monthly renewal.
reference.resetmaxCapsHowManyTimesAutoRenewMayFire: ResetMax caps how many times auto-renew may fire; 0 means no cap.
reference.resetweekdayRenewsWeeklyAtPanelLocalMidn: ResetWeekday renews weekly at panel-local midnight: 1 Monday through 7 Sunday.
reference.clientssummaryCollectsPerBucketCountsPlu:
ClientsSummary collects per-bucket counts plus the matching email lists so
the clients page can render the dashboard stat cards and their hover
popovers without shipping the full client array. The counters are exact;
the lists stop at clientSummaryEmailCap entries and only back the popovers.
reference.fallbackparentinfoCarriesEverythingTheFr:
FallbackParentInfo carries everything the frontend needs to rewrite a
child inbound's client link: where to connect (the master's address
and port) and which path matched on the master's fallbacks array.
The frontend already has the master inbound in its dbInbounds list,
so we only ship identifiers + the match path here.
reference.geocategoryIsOneCodeInsideADatabaseSuchA: GeoCategory is one code inside a database, such as geosite's "google".
reference.geocategorypageIsOnePageOfCategoriesPlus: GeoCategoryPage is one page of categories plus the unpaged total.
reference.geoentryIsASingleRuleInsideACategoryADom:
GeoEntry is a single rule inside a category: a domain rule for geosite
databases, a CIDR for geoip ones.
reference.geoentrypageIsOnePageOfCategoryEntriesPl: GeoEntryPage is one page of category entries plus the unpaged total.
reference.geofileDescribesOneDatDatabaseFoundInThe: GeoFile describes one .dat database found in the asset directory.
reference.geodatatokenissueReportsARoutingTokenThe:
GeodataTokenIssue reports a routing token the running core would reject,
or would silently match nothing against.
reference.historyofseedersTracksWhichDatabaseSeede: HistoryOfSeeders tracks which database seeders have been executed to prevent re-running.
reference.finalmaskIsAJSONObjectOfXrayFinalmaskMas:
FinalMask is a JSON object of xray finalmask masks (tcp/udp/quicParams),
merged into this host's JSON-subscription stream. Empty = no override.
reference.singleVLESSRouteValue065535BakedIntoTheS:
Single VLESS route value (0-65535) baked into the subscription UUID's 3rd
group (bytes 6-7), which xray reads via net.PortFromBytes(id[6:8]). Empty = none.
reference.hwidslotstatusIsTheAggregateDeviceSlotVi:
HwidSlotStatus is the aggregate device-slot view exposed to subscribers:
counters only, no hwid value or hash, no email, no device metadata.
reference.inboundRepresentsAnXrayInboundConfigurat: Inbound represents an Xray inbound configuration with traffic statistics and settings.
reference.whetherToOmitThisInboundFromSubscription: Whether to omit this inbound from subscription output while keeping it operational
reference.fallbackparentIsPopulatedByTheAPILayerWh:
FallbackParent is populated by the API layer when this inbound is
attached as a fallback child of a VLESS/Trojan TCP-TLS master.
The frontend uses it to rewrite client-share links so they advertise
the master's externally reachable endpoint instead of the child's
loopback listen. Not persisted.
reference.originnodeguidIsThePanelGuidOfTheNodeTha:
OriginNodeGuid is the panelGuid of the node that physically hosts this
inbound, propagated up across hops (#4983). Empty for an inbound that
lives on this panel's own xray; set to the originating node's GUID when
the inbound was synced from a node (kept as-is across further hops). Lets
the master attribute a deeply nested inbound to the real node instead of
the intermediate one it was fetched through.
reference.sortOrderOfThisInboundSLinksInSubscripti: Sort order of this inbound's links in subscription output only (lower first; negatives allowed; 0/omitted → 1; ties by id)
reference.dayOfMonthForMonthlyTrafficResets: Day of month for monthly traffic resets
reference.inboundclientipsStoresIPAddressesAssocia: InboundClientIps stores IP addresses associated with inbound clients for access control.
reference.awgserverCarriesTheFullAmneziaWGServerBl:
AwgServer carries the full AmneziaWG server block (keys, subnet,
obfuscation params) so the clients page can render a downloadable
per-client .conf without a second round trip.
reference.shareHostResolutionInputsMirroringTheSub:
Share-host resolution inputs, mirroring the subscription's

reference.fieldsTheServerFillsInWhenTheyAreOmitted:
Fields the server fills in when they are omitted — a valid value sent by the caller is never overwritten. Re-adding an email that already exists, with its stored `subId`, reuses the stored `id`, `password`, `auth` and `secret` instead of minting new ones, so the identity stays in sync across its inbounds.

- **VLESS / VMess** — `id`, a fresh UUID
- **Trojan** — `password`
- **Shadowsocks** — `password`. On a `2022-blake3-*` inbound a supplied password that does not base64-decode to the key length of the cipher (16 or 32 bytes) is replaced by a generated key and the call still succeeds, so read the client back if you did not let the server pick. Legacy ciphers keep any non-empty password
- **Hysteria** — `auth`
- **mtproto** — `secret`, a FakeTLS secret derived from the fronting domain of the inbound, or from `www.cloudflare.com` when it has none
- **WireGuard** — `privateKey` and `publicKey` when both are blank, or `publicKey` alone when only a `privateKey` was sent, plus `allowedIPs`: one free `/32` taken from the /24 the existing peers of that inbound already sit in, or from `10.0.0.0/24` when it has none

Accepted on the same body but never generated: `preSharedKey` and `keepAlive` (WireGuard), `adTag` (mtproto).

WireGuard is the only one of these that can fail. Allocation widens the search to the containing /16 before giving up with `inbound <id>: wireguard: no free address available in <scope>`, and an `allowedIPs` supplied by the caller is validated instead of allocated: `inbound <id>: wireguard: allowedIPs entry <entry> overlaps <address> used by another client` when its range overlaps an address or prefix a different client of that same inbound holds, or `... used by a client on <inbound>` when the holder sits on another WireGuard or AmneziaWG inbound. Ranges are compared, not strings, so `10.0.0.9/24` collides with `10.0.0.5/32`; a `0.0.0.0/0` or `::/0` default route claims no address. Allocation likewise skips every address inside a prefix another client holds. The same validation runs on POST /panel/api/clients/{email}/attach, where a client that already carries an address brings it along.

An `inboundIds` entry that names no existing inbound rejects the whole call before anything is written. Past that, the inbounds are applied concurrently and independently: one that fails no longer stops the others, so a `success:false` response can still have created the client on the rest. Every error names the inbound it came from (`inbound 7: <message>`), and several failures are reported together, one per line. `limitHwid` is applied only when every inbound succeeded, so re-run the call after fixing the failure.

reference.tcpForFastDialOnlyProbesUDPTransportOutb: "tcp" for fast dial-only probes (UDP-transport outbounds are still probed over HTTP), "real" for real-delay probes whose delay is the full request time including tunnel establishment. Default/empty routes an HTTP request through each outbound and reports the warm per-request round-trip.
reference.liveStateOfRoutingBalancersInTheRunningC: Live state of routing balancers in the running core (RoutingService.GetBalancerInfo): current override and the targets the strategy prefers. Returns a map keyed by balancer tag.
reference.forceABalancerInTheRunningCoreToAlwaysPi: Force a balancer in the running core to always pick one outbound (RoutingService.OverrideBalancerTarget). Applied live without a restart and kept across config saves; cleared when Xray restarts or the target outbound is removed.
reference.outboundTagToForceItMustExistInTheRunnin: Outbound tag to force; it must exist in the running config. Empty clears the override and returns control to the strategy.
reference.askTheRunningCoreWhichOutboundItsRouterW: Ask the running core which outbound its router would pick for a synthetic connection (RoutingService.TestRoute). No traffic is sent.
reference.targetDomainEitherDomainOrIpIsRequired: Target domain. Either domain or ip is required.
reference.targetIPEitherDomainOrIpIsRequired: Target IP. Either domain or ip is required.
reference.sniffedProtocolSuchAsHttpTlsBittorrentOp: Sniffed protocol such as http, tls, bittorrent (optional).
reference.listTheGeoDatabasesDatFilesInTheXrayAsse: List the geo databases (.dat files) in the Xray asset folder, with the layout detected from their contents, size, modification time and category count. A database that fails to parse is still listed, with the reason in "error".
reference.onePageOfADatabaseSCategoriesEachWithIts: One page of a database's categories, each with its entry count and the attributes its domains carry (e.g. "ads", "cn").
reference.databaseFileNameInsideTheAssetFolderEGGe: Database file name inside the asset folder, e.g. geosite.dat (required).
reference.caseInsensitiveSubstringFilterOnTheCateg: Case-insensitive substring filter on the category code.
reference.rowsToReturnCappedAt500OmitItToReturn: Rows to return, capped at 500. Omit it to return every category — the index is small and the panel filters it client-side.
reference.onePageOfTheRulesInsideACategoryDomainRu: One page of the rules inside a category — domain rules typed as domain/full/keyword/regexp for geosite databases, CIDRs for geoip ones.
reference.databaseFileNameInsideTheAssetFolderRequ: Database file name inside the asset folder (required).
reference.caseInsensitiveSubstringFilterOnTheRuleV: Case-insensitive substring filter on the rule value.
reference.rowsToReturnCappedAt500DefaultsToTheCap: Rows to return, capped at 500. Defaults to the cap.
reference.checkRoutingTokensAgainstTheDatabasesOnD: Check routing tokens against the databases on disk and return only the ones that do not resolve. Plain domains and CIDRs are ignored. Each issue carries a reason: syntax, fileMissing or categoryMissing.
reference.commaSeparatedRoutingTokensEGGeositeGoog: Comma-separated routing tokens, e.g. "geosite:google,geosite:blabla". Max 500 per request.
reference.ipToParseTheTokensAsIPRulesGeoipExt: "ip" to parse the tokens as IP rules (geoip:, ext-ip:, leading !). Anything else parses them as domain rules (geosite:, ext-site:).
reference.listAllOutboundSubscriptionsRemoteURLsTh: List all outbound subscriptions (remote URLs that supply additional outbounds), newest first.
reference.createAnOutboundSubscriptionTheURLIsFetc: Create an outbound subscription. The URL is fetched, parsed into outbounds with stable tags, and merged additively into the running Xray config.
reference.subscriptionURLRequiredMustBeAPublicHttp: Subscription URL (required). Must be a public http(s) address; private/internal targets are blocked unless allowPrivate is true.
reference.prefixForGeneratedOutboundTagsDefaultsTo: Prefix for generated outbound tags. Defaults to the lowest free "sub<N>-" prefix.
reference.customUserAgentSentWhenFetchingThisSubsc: Custom User-Agent sent when fetching this subscription. Defaults to "3x-ui-outbound-sub/1.0".
reference.whetherTheSubscriptionIsActiveDefaultTru: Whether the subscription is active. Default true.
reference.allowTheURLToPointAtAPrivateInternalLoop: Allow the URL to point at a private/internal/loopback address. Default false.
reference.skipTLSCertificateVerificationWhenFetchi: Skip TLS certificate verification when fetching the subscription's URL. Default false.
reference.placeThisSubscriptionSOutboundsBeforeThe: Place this subscription's outbounds before the manual template outbounds. Default false.
reference.updateAnExistingOutboundSubscriptionById: Update an existing outbound subscription by id. Accepts the same form fields as create.
reference.deleteAnOutboundSubscriptionById: Delete an outbound subscription by id.
reference.deleteAnOutboundSubscriptionByIdPOSTAlia: Delete an outbound subscription by id (POST alias of DELETE for clients that cannot send DELETE).
reference.forceAnImmediateReFetchOfTheSubscription: Force an immediate re-fetch of the subscription and return the parsed outbounds. Signals Xray to reload.
reference.reorderASubscriptionOneStepUpOrDownInPri: Reorder a subscription one step up or down in priority (controls its position in the merged outbounds).
reference.upToRaisePriorityAnythingElseToLowerIt: "up" to raise priority, anything else to lower it.
reference.previewASubscriptionURLFetchAndParseItIn: Preview a subscription URL: fetch and parse it into outbounds without persisting anything.
reference.customUserAgentSentWhileFetchingThePrevi: Custom User-Agent sent while fetching the preview.
reference.allowAPrivateInternalLoopbackURLDefaultF: Allow a private/internal/loopback URL. Default false.
reference.skipTLSCertificateVerificationDefaultFal: Skip TLS certificate verification. Default false.
reference.listAllSubscriptionBalancersInSortOrderS: List all subscription balancers in sort order (sort_order asc, id asc).
reference.createASubscriptionBalancerItAppearsInTh: Create a subscription balancer. It appears in the JSON subscription of every client that sits on at least one selected inbound.
reference.displayLabelUsedAsTheConfigRemarksRequir: Display label, used as the config remarks (required).
reference.repeatedFormKeysSelectingTheMemberInboun: Repeated form keys selecting the member inbounds (required, at least one).
reference.leastloadOnlyJSONObjectMappingInboundIdT: leastLoad only: JSON object mapping inbound id to a static weight > 0, e.g. {"3":0.2}. Lower weight = picked more often; absent ids weigh 1. Rejected for other strategies; entries for unselected inbounds are dropped.
reference.1BasedPositionInTheSubscriptionListDefau: 1-based position in the subscription list. Default 1.
reference.whetherTheBalancerIsEmittedDefaultTrueOn: Whether the balancer is emitted. Default true on create; unchanged when omitted on update.
reference.updateABalancerByIdAcceptsTheSameFormFie: Update a balancer by id. Accepts the same form fields as create (full-row update); omitting memberWeights clears stored weights, while omitting enabled keeps its current value.
reference.deleteABalancerByIdPOSTAliasOfDELETEFor: Delete a balancer by id (POST alias of DELETE for clients that cannot send DELETE).
reference.returnBase64EncodedSubscriptionLinksForA: Return base64-encoded subscription links for all enabled clients matching the subscription ID. When the request has an Accept: text/html header or ?html=1, renders a styled info page instead. With ?format=info, returns the page view-model as JSON (traffic, expiry, online status; no links) for live polling. The path prefix is configured by subPath.
reference.setToInfoToGetTheSubscriptionStatusViewM: Set to "info" to get the subscription status view-model as JSON instead of the links.
reference.returnTheSameStatusAndSubscriptionMetada: Return the same status and subscription metadata headers as GET without a response body.
reference.subscriptionIsAvailableHeadersMatchGETNo: Subscription is available. Headers match GET; no response body.
reference.noEnabledClientMatchesTheSubscriptionID: No enabled client matches the subscription ID.
reference.returnAggregateHWIDDeviceSlotUsageForThe: Return aggregate HWID device-slot usage for the subscription: whether an HWID limit is active, the limit, how many devices are registered and how many slots remain. Read-only — it never registers a device, so asking does not consume a slot. Counters only: no HWID value, email or device metadata. The path prefix is configured by subPath.
reference.respondsWithTheBareHwidSlotStatusObjectN: Responds with the bare HwidSlotStatus object, not the {success,msg,obj} panel envelope, like the other subscription-server routes. With no HWID limit configured, active is false and every counter is 0.
reference.noEnabledClientMatchesTheSubscriptionIDE: No enabled client matches the subscription ID. Empty body.
reference.returnTheHWIDDeviceSlotStatusCodeAndHead: Return the HWID device-slot status code and headers as GET without a response body.
reference.headersMatchGETNoResponseBody: Headers match GET; no response body.
reference.returnSubscriptionAsAJSONArrayOfProxyCon: Return subscription as a JSON array of proxy configs (one per enabled client). Only when JSON subscription is enabled in settings. The path prefix is configured by subJsonPath.
reference.returnTheJSONSubscriptionStatusAndMetada: Return the JSON subscription status and metadata headers without a body. Registered only when JSON subscriptions are enabled.
reference.returnSubscriptionAsAClashMihomoCompatib: Return subscription as a Clash/Mihomo-compatible YAML config, including configured global Clash routing rules. Only when Clash subscription is enabled in settings. The path prefix is configured by subClashPath.
reference.returnTheClashSubscriptionStatusAndMetad: Return the Clash subscription status and metadata headers without a body. Registered only when Clash subscriptions are enabled.
reference.upgradeAnHTTPConnectionToAWebSocketRequi: Upgrade an HTTP connection to a WebSocket. Requires an authenticated session cookie (Bearer token auth is not supported here). Returns 101 Switching Protocols on success. The server then pushes JSON messages described below.
reference.switchingProtocolsWebSocketMessagesUseWe: Switching Protocols. WebSocket messages use WebSocketEnvelope.
reference.serverHealthSnapshotPushedEveryTwoSecond: Server health snapshot pushed every two seconds; same payload as server/status obj.
reference.liveTrafficDeltasPlusOnlinePerNodeAndLas: Live traffic deltas plus online, per-node and last-online maps. TUIC also sends source-tagged client deltas with their sampling interval for live speed.
reference.presentForNativeTUICSamplesOmittedXraySa: Present for native TUIC samples; omitted Xray samples default to xray.
reference.samplingIntervalUsedToCalculateClientSpe: Sampling interval used to calculate client speed, in milliseconds.
reference.absoluteClientCountersAndOrInboundSummar: Absolute client counters and/or inbound summaries; snapshot says whether clients is complete or only recently active rows.
reference.fullInboundListAfterAnInboundMutationUnl: Full inbound list after an inbound mutation, unless invalidate is used at scale.
reference.currentOutboundTrafficRowsAfterThePeriod: Current outbound traffic rows after the periodic traffic collection.
reference.currentNodeTreeAfterTheHeartbeatProbeCyc: Current node tree after the heartbeat probe cycle.
reference.anInPanelNotificationEmittedByServerActi: An in-panel notification emitted by server actions.
reference.xrayProcessStateChangeAfterAStopRestartO: Xray process state change after a stop, restart or error.
reference.requestsARESTReFetchClientsIsAnInvalidat: Requests a REST re-fetch. clients is an invalidate payload type, not a top-level event.
